Prime Niagara Falls investment opportunity! 

Welcome to 650 Orchard Parkway, ideally located just minutes from Niagara Falls and the Rainbow Bridge, offering exceptional potential as a short-term rental/Airbnb or personal residence. The property’s highly desirable location places guests close to world-famous attractions, dining, entertainment, shopping, and the Canadian border. With reported short-term rental income potential of approximately $50,000–$60,000 annually, this property presents an exciting opportunity for investors looking to capitalize on Niagara Falls’ strong tourism market. Whether you're expanding your investment portfolio, looking for an Airbnb opportunity, or searching for a home near the Falls, this property offers location, convenience, and income-producing potential.
